title: Niagara Falls Private Day Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of five people per booking
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately

Terms and Conditions for Infants and Toddlers Traveling on Our Vehicles Seat Requirement: All infants and toddlers traveling on our vehicles are required to occupy their own seat. For safety purposes, they must be secured in a government-approved car seat or booster seat appropriate for their age, height, and weight. Car Seat or Booster Seat Provision: It is the responsibility of the client to bring their own government-approved car seat or booster seat for their child.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private, guided, 7-hour tour to Niagara Falls from Toronto. 

Travel in comfort with an air conditioned vehicle, available for groups with up to five passengers, and learn the history of Canada and the Niagara region along the way. 

Then, explore the beauty Niagara Falls with more flexibility. Visit personal areas of interest or take in the suggested attractions, like the 'Journey Behind the Falls,' the famous Floral Clock, and Niagara-on-the-Lake wine country. 

There is so much to see and do on this relaxing day trip. Toronto hotel pickup and drop-off included.
